name: OPERATION MANUAL A
content:
OPERATION MANUAL A - BASIC MOVEMENT. 

Use WASD and the left mouse to move and rotate the camera. Click and hold the left mouse button to use the flashlight but be aware of the noise it generates.|Use Q and E to lean left and right. ESC will temporarily suspend the horror. F will allow you to interact with the environment when an indicator is displayed.|Use I to open your inventory to check your status, items, files, and change the options. Finally, good luck.
